concept: A serene first-light terrace where the first gold of morning turns one gentle beginning into something worth greeting.
floor: One broad continuous pale-peach sunrise floor across the full top face, formed from only six to eight oversized softly beveled stone slabs with no rays, mosaic, rug, or separate path.
main_structure: One broad open-front cream sunrise pavilion at the rear with a softly arched peach roof and one oversized half-sun disc glowing above the open horizon window.
rear_props: one broad morning table with one oversized teapot and two large cup forms
two large golden dawn lanterns flanking the rear pavilion
side_props: one chunky curved waking bench and one oversized closed morning journal on the upper-left edge
one simple water basin with one broad dew-drop ornament and one rounded pale-sage shrub on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth peach-and-cream sunrise parapet with broad rounded capstones
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple half-sun and dew-drop emblems

materials: a few broad muted-gold stone blocks

lighting: soft luminous dawn light with one broad horizon glow and two large warm-gold lantern pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open pale-peach sunrise floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, bird, person, or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, sunburst platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable journal text, labels, watermark, external shadow
tiny dew droplets, sparkles, sun rays, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense texture
